hook.en: The nearest land is a tiny island in thousands of kilometres of sea. Miss it, and there is nothing else. Can the captain find it?

objectives.en: Describe how the family reached safety
Explain the qualities shown by the characters

narration.en: The nearest land is a tiny island in thousands of kilometres of sea. Miss it, and there is nothing else. Can the captain find it?

body.en: With the boat crippled, the narrator worked out their position and found that the nearest land was Ile Amsterdam, a tiny French island in the southern Indian Ocean with a scientific base. He set a course for it, knowing that if they missed this small speck of land they would be lost in the open ocean. When the island finally rose on the horizon, Jonathan called his father the best daddy and the best captain in the world. They reached the island safely and were helped by the people there.

points.en: Nearest land: Ile Amsterdam, a tiny French island
Safe landing; help from the islanders

Let us build the theme web of the account.

say.en: At the centre is survival; around it, the qualities that made it possible.
The captain leads calmly and navigates well.
Preparation and drills save their lives.

body.en: The account celebrates courage and optimism in the face of disaster. It shows how careful preparation, teamwork and good leadership can make survival possible. Above all, it shows the strength of family love: the children's bravery and their wish to be together give the adults the will to fight on.

problem.en: Show how the narrator proved himself a good leader.

steps.en: He prepared the boat and crew carefully before the storm.
Though injured, he repaired the boat and rigged a spare pump.
He calculated their position and steered to a tiny island.

answer.en: The narrator prepared thoroughly, stayed calm when the wave struck, repaired the boat despite his injuries, and used careful navigation to find tiny Ile Amsterdam. His calm, skilled leadership saved everyone on board.
